content: Install emergentintegrations library for LLM chat integration
Retrieve Emergent LLM key using emergent_integrations_manager tool
Create quiz service with LLM integration (quiz_service.py) for question generation and evaluation
Create QuizSession and QuizResult MongoDB models (models/quiz.py)
Create quiz routes (routers/quiz_routes.py) with session management endpoints
Add quiz routes to server.py and test backend with curl
Create QuizConfigModal for quiz settings (questions count, types, mode)
Create QuizResults screen with celebration effects
Add quiz CSS styling following design guidelines
Check frontend for compilation errors and fix any issues
